title: Merge half-open intervals
description: Implement merge_intervals(intervals). intervals is an iterable of (start, end) pairs of numbers representing half-open ranges [start, end). Return a new sorted list of (start, end) tuples where overlapping OR touching ranges (one's end equals the next's start) are merged into one. Empty ranges (start == end) are dropped. Raise ValueError if any pair has start > end. Input need not be sorted and must not be mutated.
invariants: Output is sorted by start, contains tuples, and no two output ranges overlap or touch.
A range fully contained in another is absorbed.
Empty ranges (start == end) are dropped, even when inside another range or touching one.
start > end raises ValueError, checked for every pair including ones that would be dropped or absorbed.
Input of any order, any iterable, and input lists are not mutated.
